1.consolidated_definition: Transbordador. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, del inglés. Véase ferry. Viaje de Santo Domingo a Puerto Rico que no sea el ferri (Foro de Puerto Rico, consultado 08-04-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Ferryboat. Adapted Anglicism, infrequently used. From English, as per DRAE 2001. See ferry. Voyage from Santo Domingo to Puerto Rico that is not the ferri (Foro de Puerto Rico, consulted on 08-04-08)
